title: ExtensionMessage
description: A detection-only tab report from the browser extension. Host, tab key, audible and meeting-present only; no URL, no title, no DOM content.

instance_id.description: The extension instance; a browser restart starts a new instance with its own seq space.

observed_at_ms.description: Extension observation time, Unix milliseconds; dropped when older than 5 s at receipt.

seq.description: Strictly increasing per instance_id; a non-increasing seq for the same instance is dropped.
